Title: BUNCO SQUAD — FORGERY #201: PIERCE & SONS WAREHOUSE

Brief.title: BUNCO SQUAD — FORGERY #201: PIERCE & SONS WAREHOUSE
body: Victim: ANGELA RUSSO — warehouse owner. The bank caught $9,000 in bad paper today.
The method: checks torn from the back of the book, where nobody looks. The bank's examiner flagged it at 11:39 PM.
Nobody outside the warehouse could have done it. The forger is still on the payroll.
OBJECTIVES
• Search the scene  • Interview all 10 suspects  • Challenge lies with evidence
• File: who forged it, what proves motive, what proves the method

Title: ROBBERY DETAIL #203: THE GRAND MERIDIAN HOTEL

Brief.title: ROBBERY DETAIL #203: THE GRAND MERIDIAN HOTEL
body: Victim: DANNY MARSH — casino floor manager. The office safe was cleaned out at 11:10 PM: $18,000.
How: the safe dialed open — first try, by the look of it. No sign of a break-in from outside.
Nobody has left since closing. The thief is still in the hotel — and so is the money, somewhere.
OBJECTIVES
• Search the scene  • Interview all 10 suspects  • Challenge lies with evidence
• File: who took it, what proves motive, what proves the method

Brief.title: CASE FILE #205: THE VELVET LOUNGE
body: Victim: GREG PIERCE — club owner. Found at 11:10 PM.
Cause of death: a single thin puncture at the base of the skull. No weapon recovered at the scene.
Several witnesses remain inside the club. Nobody has been allowed to leave.
OBJECTIVES

• Interview all 10 suspects       (press E near them)
• CHALLENGE statements with contradicting evidence
• File your verdict at the Captain's desk
